propositions: Op-cert service must accept exactly one source (REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY) at startup, validate it before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, and reject missing, both-set, unreadable, non-regular, malformed, encrypted, or non-Ed25519 input.
Process must copy validated key to process-owned 0700 directory with 0600-mode file, never modify/delete the deployment source, and observe replacement only after restart.

Application binding must thread an immutable context-local OpcertSigner through both producer signing chains (completion and plan-review) via mint_opcert_record, sign_manifest, and sign_completion_verdict, isolating concurrent/timed-out jobs.

Op-cert application runtime must remove all SSM, boto3, AWS_REGION, and REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM dependencies; the key must be materialized before start by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file bind-mounted readonly with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
Developer-local close/review-plan callers must pass no binding and retain environment/genesis default resolution; hosted service must supply startup-bound context-local signer to both job dispatches.
Push policy (REBAR_SYNC_PUSH/_push_mode) must route to context-local policy when bound, environment default otherwise; no workspace push remote allowed under binding.
